build_ResNetEncoder: build a ResNetEncoder to encode input images into latent space representations for LDM autoencoder
build_ResNetDecoder: build a ResNetDecoder to decode latent representations back into output images for LDM autoencoder
create_res_block_stack: create a stack of residual blocks with optional downsampling or upsampling for VAE architecture
create_res_block: create a single residual block with configurable channels and optional skip connection for VAE
test_ResNetEncoder_forward: test the ResNetEncoder forward pass with a sample input tensor of shape [b, c, h, w]
